children: The deputy governor of Russia's central bank, Alexei Zabotkin, said on Monday that new budget parameters did not differ significantly from those that the regulator had previously outlined.
Earlier, Finance Minister Anton Siluanov said on Monday that the 2026 budget may see a deficit of up to 3% of GDP.
